agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario violates no_wall_penetration at step 13 due to high-speed corner penetration after body-body collision. At step 5 bodies 0 and 1 collide (gap ~0.002), accelerating body 0 to ~58 m/s (vx~28, vy~-50). Body 0 then skims the top-right corner of the thin wall (15.8,2.2,3.3x0.4). Distance_to_surface decays 0.467 at step10 ->0.237 at step11 ->0.014 at step12 -> -0.1526 at step13 (beyond 0.15 limit), showing missed/insufficient positional correction at the corner despite 9 substeps (dt=0.0045). Reducing dt to 0.001 (shorter substeps, finer CCD) eliminates penetration while keeping steps identical, confirming substep/CCD insufficiency at high speed as cause.
